# A5.01 Task plan

## Owner
A5

## Stage
Build

## Phase
1

## Checkpoint
—

## Input (reads)
One task from A4.09 with its story and design files

## Steps
1. List files to create or change.
2. List tests to write.
3. List risks.
4. Save the plan before coding

## Output (writes)
Task plan

## Save path
`docs/sdlc/build/plans/<task-ID>.md`

## Verification
Plan lists every file the PR changes
